task: Geo-based multi-warehouse order balancing. Route orders to the optimal fulfillment center by inventory and distance; split only if a single node cannot fulfill.
checklist: Routing engine evaluates stock availability across all nodes
Lowest shipping cost is calculated from customer ZIP
Single-node fulfillment is preferred when possible
Order is split into multiple shipments only when no single node can fulfill it
Negative: zero stock across all nodes -> order flagged as backorder, NOT routed to an empty node
Edge: a node goes offline mid-routing -> order re-routes, no silent drop
Edge: tie in cost/distance between nodes -> deterministic tie-break rule applied
Partial stock at the cheapest node -> split logic weighs cost trade-off correctly
Audit: routing decision and its reason are logged
